description:
STEP-THROUGH COMMUTER DESIGN - The low-step frame makes getting on and off the electric bicycle easier and supports a comfortable, upright riding position. Ideal for daily commuting, neighborhood trips, recreational rides, and running everyday errands.

INTUITIVE ELECTRIC ASSIST CONTROLS - The handlebar-mounted LCD display provides convenient access to pedal-assist settings and essential riding information, including speed and battery status. Easy-to-reach controls let riders adjust assistance while keeping their attention on the road.

FRONT SUSPENSION & COMFORT SADDLE - The front suspension fork helps absorb vibration and bumps on city streets and uneven paths. Combined with the wide ergonomic saddle and comfortable handlebar position, it provides a smoother experience on longer rides.

RESPONSIVE DUAL DISC BRAKES - Front and rear disc brakes deliver dependable stopping control in changing riding conditions. Full-coverage fenders help reduce splashes from wet or dusty roads, while the front headlight improves visibility during early-morning and evening travel.

COMMUTER-READY ACCESSORIES - The integrated rear cargo rack provides convenient space for compatible bags, baskets, or daily essentials. Practical features including fenders, a headlight, adjustable seating, and a stable step-through frame make this e-bike ready for everyday transportation.
